others.name: WISDOM FOCUS GROUP LTD.
others.role: Largest shareholder, owned by the CEO and CFO

what: It is a Tokyo-based company that trades waste paper, paper pulp and scrap metal across East Asia and Southeast Asia.
proceeds: It plans to spend the money on growing in other markets (30%), building an AI trading system (20%), and buying or building facilities (20%). It will also use it for new recyclable products (15%) and general working capital (15%).
risks: Past results do not guarantee future results, because they change with the economy, interest rates and customer confidence.
It must keep improving its trade-matching system, or the system may become out of date and hurt its ability to compete.
It relies on suppliers for all its products and has no long-term supply contracts, so supply problems could hurt the business.
Its sales depend on consumer demand and spending in Japan, East Asia and Southeast Asia, which factors outside its control can change.
It relies on a small number of major suppliers, and losing business from them could seriously hurt its results.
